source_documents.title: Achieving Charge‐Transfer‐Featured Organic Room‐Temperature Phosphorescence with Combined High Efficiency and Long Lifetime via V‐Shaped D–A Dyads

reference_evidence_units.quote: This improvement stems from preserving a substantial degree of forbiddenness in the radiative transition process of the compound while simultaneously increasing its D–A dihedral angle, which can promote more efficient spin-orbit coupling and thus more rapid intersystem crossing.
reference_evidence_units.subject: V-1, V-2
reference_evidence_units.statement: Long-lived, efficient RTP comes from a forbidden radiative transition plus faster ISC at a larger D-A angle.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The positive solvatochromism in its Fl spectrum verifies the 1 CT feature of the S1 state of V-1
reference_evidence_units.subject: V-1

reference_evidence_units.quote: Further nanosecond TA measurements reveal that, akin to U-1, V1 progresses the ISC from its 1 CT-typed S1 to 3 LEA -typed T1 states in Tol, i.e., governed by a SOCT-ISC effect (Figure S7).
reference_evidence_units.subject: V-1
reference_evidence_units.statement: ISC goes from 1CT to the acceptor-localised 3LE (SOCT-ISC).

reference_evidence_units.quote: V-1@PMMA not only exhibits a long τ Ph of 152 ms (Figure 2b), but also demonstrates a high ΦPh of 25%, which is threefold higher than that of U-1@PMMA.
reference_evidence_units.subject: V-1
reference_evidence_units.statement: RTP with τPh 152 ms and ΦPh 25%.

reference_evidence_units.quote: verify the occurrence of a T1 (3 LE)→T2 (3 CT) reverse internal conversion (RIC) process in V1@PMMA at ambient conditions
reference_evidence_units.subject: V-1
reference_evidence_units.statement: The emitting triplet is reached by reverse internal conversion from 3LE to 3CT.

reference_evidence_units.quote: indicating that the phenyl substitution enhances both SOCME and the forbiddenness of the radiative transition process.
reference_evidence_units.subject: V-2 vs V-1
reference_evidence_units.statement: V-2 has larger kISC and smaller kFl than V-1.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: S1 is a CT state (positive solvatochromism) and the emitting triplet has CT character, which the CT-mediated ISC (SOCT-ISC) relies on; the performance itself is explained by rates.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The abstract explains the long lifetime and high efficiency by keeping the radiative 3CT→S0 transition forbidden (small kPh) while speeding up ISC; rate constants are measured.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Ambient RTP in PMMA (τPh 152 ms, ΦPh 25%) reached by SOCT-ISC (ns TA).

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The D-A framework is called more rigid, lowering knr,T, but no specific intramolecular motion is named (guideline §3.3); not labelled RIM.

contrast_group.paper_difference: The diphenyl donor (V-2) raises kISC, lowers kFl and stiffens the D-A framework, lowering knr,T and lengthening τPh.

basis: route: 9,9-dimethylacridan + 1-bromo-2-iodobenzene (N-arylation), then Suzuki coupling with the naphthalimide boronate (SI)
structure_verification.note: The SI calls the precursor a 2-bromobenzyl/benzyl compound, but it is made from 1-bromo-2-iodobenzene and the HRMS fits the N-aryl (no CH2) structure, as does the V shape; written without CH2 (guideline §3.6).
